t: This is a statue of William Booth in Denmark Hill, made by the sculptor George Edward Wade. Booth was an English Methodist preacher who, together with his wife Catherine, founded the Salvation Army and became its first General, serving from 1878 until 1912. The movement began in London in 1865 and has spread to many parts of the world, and it is one of the largest distributors of humanitarian aid. Wade was a largely self-taught British sculptor, best remembered for his statues of royalty and politicians.
